plugins.name: ecom
plugins.description: Agent skills for running a Shopify store with a coding agent: catalog cleanup, category taxonomy, SEO metadata, alt text, Matrixify, redirects, JSON-LD, and landing-page ideation

skills.name: ecom-landing-pages
skills.description: Use when someone wants landing page ideas, concepts, or angles for a store: "give me landing page concepts", "LP ideas", "landing page angles", a campaign or ad landing page, pages for a new audience/segment, a seasonal/event/promo page, or a geo/local page. Also use when a chosen concept gets picked and needs building out into an actual page (section-by-section blueprint), or when auditing an existing landing page against best practice. The core insight: one product becomes dozens of pages by varying the ANGLE, not the product. Not for full-site information architecture, product detail pages, collection pages, or blog/SEO content (a landing page has ONE goal, no site chrome). Use an SEO/content skill. Not for the ad or email creative itself, though message match with the page matters.
headings: 3. Key each candidate to a traffic source
5. Output: lead with the ranked table
skills.description_zh: 为电商按受众、活动、季节或地区提出落地页角度，选定后生成逐区块蓝图，也可审计现有页；通过变换角度为同产品造单目标页面。不用于全站架构、产品详情、集合页、博客 SEO 或广告邮件创意本身。

skills.name: shopify-alt-text
skills.description: Use when backfilling missing image alt text on a Shopify store: images with no alt attribute, accessibility alt text for product images, alt text for Files library images, image SEO, or a WCAG/accessibility pass that flags images missing text alternatives. Triggers: "backfill alt text", "fill in missing alt text", "images have no alt", "add alt attributes for accessibility", "image SEO sweep". One mutation, fileUpdate, covers both product media and the Files library. Not for meta titles/descriptions (use shopify-seo-metadata).
skills.description_zh: 补齐 Shopify 产品图片及 Files 库缺失的可访问替代文本，支持图片 SEO 和无文字替代审计，统一用 fileUpdate 修改；不用于 SEO 标题描述，后者用 shopify-seo-metadata。

skills.name: shopify-catalog-audit
skills.description: Use when someone wants to find product-data problems across a Shopify catalog: "audit my catalog", "find PDP problems", "which products have missing photos / thin or missing descriptions / pricing anomalies", "$0 or compare-at-inverted prices", "products missing type or vendor", "catalog quality sweep", "product data health check", "which listings are broken", "run a catalog audit before a big sale". Read-only: it locates and ranks problems, it does not change anything. Not for FIXING the problems it finds (use shopify-catalog-cleanup for debris/archiving, shopify-seo-metadata for missing SEO meta, shopify-alt-text for missing image alt text).
skills.description_zh: 只读审计 Shopify 商品数据，定位排序缺图、薄描述、零价或比较价倒置、缺类型供应商等问题，不改动。清理用 catalog-cleanup，SEO 元数据用 seo-metadata，图片 alt 用 alt-text。

skills.name: shopify-catalog-cleanup
skills.description: Use when fixing the debris an audit found in a Shopify catalog: bulk-archive dead/discontinued/zero-inventory products, clean up catalog debris, kill ghost review stars (empty star ratings a theme still renders after a review app was uninstalled), remove orphaned metafields left by an uninstalled app, strip HTML artifacts from product descriptions (double-nested bold, fully-bold paragraphs, empty tags), or fix messed-up / mangled product descriptions in bulk. Mutating cleanup work: archive vs delete, metafieldsDelete, description rewrites. Not for FINDING what''s wrong (use shopify-catalog-audit) or filling missing metadata like SEO titles and alt text (use shopify-seo-metadata).
headings: The one rule: preview count, then mutate
how many products are already archived, and a metafield namespace sample
skills.description_zh: 修复审计发现的 Shopify 目录残留，批量归档停产或无库存商品、移除卸载评价插件的幽灵星级和孤立 metafield，清除描述 HTML 异常及批量重写。属于修改操作，区分归档与删除；发现问题用 catalog-audit，补 SEO 或 alt 用对应技能。

skills.name: shopify-category-taxonomy
skills.description: Use when you assign the Shopify Standard Product Taxonomy category, "set the product category", "categorize the catalog", or fill the category / taxonomy metafields: the admin "Category metafields" panel (Color, Size, Material, Caffeine content), a.k.a. product category attributes / taxonomy attributes, including the attributes a Google feed asks for. Covers bulk classification, discovering a category''s attributes and allowed values, minting the reserved value metaobjects, and writing them safely. Also: "category metafields show blank/null", "my Color attribute won''t save". Not for bulk CSV data loads (Matrixify can''t do this; see shopify-matrixify for bulk data).
headings: preview (read-only): how many products your classifier targets, before any write
then, per high-confidence product, assign the category
1. token reaches the store and reads a product's assigned category
skills.description_zh: 设置 Shopify 标准产品分类及颜色、尺寸、材料等分类属性，批量分类、发现允许属性值、创建保留值 metaobject 并安全写入，也诊断空属性及无法保存。Matrixify 不支持这类分类字段；普通批量数据用 shopify-matrixify。

skills.name: shopify-json-ld
skills.description: Use when adding structured data / JSON-LD / schema markup to a Shopify store: recipe, FAQ, Article/BlogPosting, CollectionPage, AboutPage, or Organization schema; chasing Google rich-results / rich-snippet eligibility; debugging a Search Console "Invalid object type" or "missing field" schema error; or a request like "add schema to my store", "add recipe schema", or "why isn''t my product showing rich results". This skill adds SUPPLEMENTAL JSON-LD the theme cannot emit dynamically, stored in a metafield and rendered by one Liquid snippet. Not for meta titles, meta descriptions, canonical tags, or Open Graph (use shopify-seo-metadata for those).
headings: Supplemental-only doctrine: audit before you generate
Two schema rules that are non-negotiable
FAQPage is not a rich-result win anymore
Verify against the Admin API, not the storefront
1. Confirm the token reaches the store.
2. Confirm a product page actually renders a JSON-LD block.
skills.description_zh: 为 Shopify 添加主题无法动态输出的补充 JSON-LD，将 Recipe、FAQ、Article/BlogPosting、CollectionPage、AboutPage 或 Organization 模式存入 metafield 并用一个 Liquid 片段渲染；用于富结果资格和模式错误。不用于标题描述、canonical 或 Open Graph。

skills.name: shopify-matrixify
skills.description: Use when a store owner is doing bulk data work through the Matrixify (formerly Excelify) app: bulk import/export, "migrate my catalog", "bulk update prices", "bulk edit metafields", CSV or Excel import, "my import deleted my metafields", "my import wiped my tags", MERGE vs REPLACE vs UPDATE, "how do I undo an import", building a Matrixify sheet by hand or programmatically, or a data migration between stores/platforms. Covers products, variants, metafields, collections, redirects, customers, and menus. Not for minting category (taxonomy) metafields, which Matrixify cannot do (use shopify-category-taxonomy); not for one-off single-record edits via the Admin API (use the relevant entity skill).
skills.description_zh: 通过 Matrixify/Excelify 批量导入导出、迁移和更新 Shopify 产品、变体、metafield、集合、跳转、客户和菜单，处理 CSV/Excel、MERGE/REPLACE/UPDATE、误覆盖及撤销。不能创建分类属性；单条 Admin API 编辑用对应实体技能。

skills.name: shopify-redirect-mapping
skills.description: Use when you need to map a pile of old URLs to live pages and turn them into 301 redirects on a Shopify store: fix 404s, bulk redirects after a migration/replatform/catalog restructure, turn a Google Search Console 404 export into live redirects, or WordPress→Shopify URL transforms (/YYYY/MM/slug/ → /products/slug). Trigger phrases: "map old URLs", "fix our 404s", "redirect the dead links", "we relaunched and lost our rankings". Recovers SEO equity and rescues users after a URL structure changes. Not for creating a single one-off redirect (do it in admin).
headings: The one rule that matters: recall over precision
Preview before you mutate; stay non-destructive
1. List existing redirects (confirms scope + shows current map)
2. Probe an old path and confirm it 301s where you expect
skills.description_zh: 将大量旧 URL 映射至 Shopify 在线页并生成 301，处理迁移重构后的 404、Search Console 导出及 WordPress URL 转换，恢复用户访问和 SEO 连续性；单条重定向直接在后台操作。

skills.name: shopify-seo-metadata
skills.description: Use when a store has missing SEO titles or meta descriptions and you want to backfill them: "backfill missing SEO titles/descriptions", "meta description sweep", "SEO meta backfill across products/collections/pages/blog posts", "missing page titles", "fix blank search-appearance metadata", "generate SEO meta for products". Safe-mode: fills only the empty search-appearance fields (SEO title, meta description) on products, collections, pages, and blog articles, never touching human-written values. Not for image alt text (use shopify-alt-text) or JSON-LD (use shopify-json-ld).
headings: Safe mode is the whole job
Preflight the LLM key with a real completion
Verify AFTER the write: via the Admin API, never the storefront
skills.description_zh: 仅填补 Shopify 产品、集合、页面和文章中为空的 SEO 标题与描述，保留人工已有值；图片替代文本及 JSON-LD 用对应技能。

skills.name: shopify-yourskill
skills.description: Use when [the specific situations, symptoms, and phrases someone would type or think when they hit this problem]. Pack real trigger words and store-owner symptoms. Describe ONLY when to use it, never summarize the workflow inside. Keep the whole frontmatter under 1024 characters. End by naming what this skill is NOT for, pointing at the sibling skill that covers it.
headings: Guidelines for a good ecom skill
confirm your token reaches the store and the API version resolves
skills.description_zh: 源说明是未填写的技能编写模板，要求作者补充实际触发情境、商店症状及排除项，并限制 frontmatter 少于 1024 字符；未提供可确认的具体业务用途。
